h2: Zoning in Langley, Surrey, White Rock, Delta, Abbotsford, Vancouver and the Fraser Valley
lead: Plain-English summaries of residential, farm, rural, acreage, commercial and industrial zones: what you can build, the smallest new lot and the height limit, with a link to the official bylaw for every zone. Type an address to see its zone, or search any zone code.
checked: Checked against each official bylaw on October 2, 2026, with fuller summaries, White Rock, City of Langley, Pitt Meadows, Coquitlam, Vancouver and Burnaby, and the urban zones of Maple Ridge, Mission and Chilliwack added November 18, 2026. Zoning changes often, so always confirm with the municipality.
general: These summaries may not reflect recent amendments and are not legal advice. Always confirm zoning, permitted uses and ALR status with the municipality and the Agricultural Land Commission before you buy.

lookup.d: Type an address to see its zoning, ALR status, lot size and other public map checks. It covers Surrey, White Rock, Langley (City and Township), Delta including Ladner and Tsawwassen, Maple Ridge, Abbotsford, Chilliwack including Sardis, Mission, Vancouver, Burnaby and Coquitlam. Anywhere else, send me the address and I'll check its zoning, ALR status and what you can build before you write an offer.
lookup.fine: General information from public municipal and provincial maps, not a survey or legal advice. The address is only used to look up public map data.

munis.name: Abbotsford
munis.source: Source: Online consolidated bylaw (laws.abbotsford.ca). All standard zones.

zones.name: Agricultural One Zone
fields: Agricultural uses and complementary activities, consistent with the Agricultural Land Commission Act.

Agriculture, one single detached dwelling, boarding house, residential care. Accessory uses include agri-tourism, farm retail sales, farm product processing, farm alcohol production, and farm worker housing.

One secondary suite (up to 100 m²). One accessory farm dwelling unit on lots of at least 0.4 ha: up to 90 m² on lots of 40 ha or less, up to 186 m² on larger lots, subject to ALR rules or ALC approval.
8.0 ha (about 19.8 acres), with limited exceptions in s.210.5.
The bylaw notes that the ALC Act and the ALR Use Regulation requirements also apply.

zones.name: Agricultural Two Zone
fields: Same agricultural and residential uses as A1.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Agricultural and Resource Processing Zone
fields: If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Agricultural and Produce Processing Zone
fields: If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Agricultural and Farm Industrial Zone
fields: A1 uses plus farm industrial use and growing medium manufacturing.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Agricultural and Commercial Mushroom Composting Zone
fields: A1 uses plus a commercial mushroom composting facility where approved by the ALC.
7.3 ha for a composting facility; otherwise same as A1.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Rural Residential Zone
fields: Single detached dwellings and agricultural uses on large lots in a rural setting.
Single detached dwelling, agriculture, resource processing, residential care, supported housing. Accessory farm retail sales.
Secondary suite; coach house only on lots over 0.4 ha.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Country Residential Zone
fields: Single detached dwellings and agricultural uses on large lots.
Secondary suite; coach house only on lots over 0.4 ha.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Suburban Residential Zone
fields: Single detached dwellings on suburban lots.
Secondary suite; coach house on lots over 0.4 ha.

zones.name: Suburban Residential Hobby Farm Zone
fields: Single detached dwellings on suburban lots with small-scale hobby farming.
A coach house on land in the ALR needs ALC approval.

zones.name: Urban Estate Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings on large urban lots.
One single detached dwelling, which can have a secondary suite.
Bed and breakfast, boarding, a home-based business, residential care, supported housing and a boarding house.
1,620 m² (about 0.4 acres), at least 30 m wide.
Floor space ratio 0.50. Lot coverage 33%. Buildings up to 9.5 m (about 31 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Urban Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings on medium urban-sized lots.
One single detached dwelling, which can have a secondary suite.
Short-term rental, boarding, a home-based business, residential care, supported housing and a boarding house.
540 m² (about 5,813 sq ft), 15 m wide and 25 m deep for an interior lot; 610 m² and 18 m wide for a corner lot.
Floor space ratio 0.50. Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 9.5 m (about 31 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: 1 Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing One Zone
fields: Intended to enable small-scale residential development on urban lots designated SSMUH 1 in the OCP.

Townhouses with up to 4 principal units. Up to 3 dwelling units on a lot of 280 m² or less and 4 on a larger lot, counting secondary suites, garden suites and coach houses. A secondary suite must be under half the size of the main home; a garden suite or coach house can be up to 15% of the lot area, to a maximum of 100 m² (about 1,076 sq ft).
495 m² (about 5,328 sq ft), at least 16.5 m wide.
Floor space ratio 0.9 for three townhouse units and 1.2 for four. Lot coverage 50% for a single detached dwelling and 75% for townhouses. Townhouses up to 11 m (about 36 ft) or three storeys.
zones.note: Summary from the City of Abbotsford's SSMUH Application Guide (January 2026), not the bylaw page.

zones.name: 2 Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing Two Zone
fields: Intended to enable small-scale residential development on urban lots designated SSMUH 2 in the OCP.

A single detached dwelling or a duplex (up to 2 principal units), plus accessory units. Up to 3 dwelling units on a lot of 280 m² or less and 4 on a larger lot, counting secondary suites, garden suites and coach houses. A secondary suite must be under half the size of the main home; a garden suite or coach house can be up to 15% of the lot area, to a maximum of 100 m² (about 1,076 sq ft).
495 m² (about 5,328 sq ft), at least 20 m wide.

Floor space ratio 0.5 for a single detached dwelling and 0.65 with a garden suite or coach house, or for a duplex. Homes up to 9.5 m (about 31 ft) or three storeys; a coach house 7.5 m or two storeys; a garden suite 4.5 m and one storey.
zones.note: Summary from the City of Abbotsford's SSMUH Application Guide (January 2026), not the bylaw page.

zones.name: 2-g Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing 2 – Greenfield Zone
fields: Intended to enable small-scale residential development on greenfield lots designated SSMUH 2 in the OCP.

zones.name: 3 Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing Three Zone
fields: Intended to enable small-scale residential development on large lots designated SSMUH 3 in the OCP.

A single detached dwelling or a duplex (up to 2 principal units), plus accessory units, on larger lots. Up to 3 dwelling units on a lot of 280 m² or less and 4 on a larger lot, counting secondary suites, garden suites and coach houses. A secondary suite must be under half the size of the main home; a garden suite or coach house can be up to 15% of the lot area, to a maximum of 100 m² (about 1,076 sq ft).

Floor space ratio 0.5 for a single detached dwelling and 0.65 with a garden suite or coach house, or for a duplex. Homes up to 9.5 m (about 31 ft) or three storeys; a coach house 7.5 m or two storeys; a garden suite 4.5 m and one storey.
zones.note: Summary from the City of Abbotsford's SSMUH Application Guide (January 2026), not the bylaw page.

zones.name: 4 Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing Four Zone
fields: Intended to enable small-scale residential development on suburban lots designated SSMUH 4 in the OCP.

A single detached dwelling or a duplex, plus accessory units: up to 3 dwelling units on a lot of 280 m² or less and 4 on a larger lot. One coach house and one garden suite per lot, each up to 15% of the lot area or 100 m² (about 1,076 sq ft), whichever is less.
Residential care, boarding, home-based businesses, short-term rental and accessory produce sales.
0.4 ha (about 1 acre), with a width of at least 25% of the lot depth.
Lot coverage 20% for buildings and 30% for all impermeable surfaces. Buildings up to 9.5 m (about 31 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Urban Residential Zone, Infill
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings on urban lots in the Urban 3-Infill Land Use Designation.
One single detached dwelling, which can have a secondary suite.
Bed and breakfast, boarding, a home-based business, residential care and a boarding house.
540 m² (about 5,813 sq ft), 15 m wide and 25 m deep for an interior lot; 610 m² and 18 m wide for a corner lot.
Floor space ratio 0.5. Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 8.5 m (about 28 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Townhouse 1 Zone
fields: Intended to enable a transition from small-scale residential development to ground-oriented multi-unit residential development on lands abutting a Local Road and designated Townhouse in the OCP.

Townhouses, duplexes and single detached dwellings. Up to 3 dwelling units on a lot of 280 m² or less and 4 on a larger lot; no maximum on a lot of 1,120 m² or more that is at least 35 m wide. Secondary suites, one garden suite and one coach house (rear lane required) per lot are allowed.
Short-term rental, boarding, home-based businesses, residential care and a boarding house.
495 m² (about 5,328 sq ft) and 16.5 m wide for an interior lot; 585 m² and 19.5 m wide for a corner lot; 22.5 m deep.

Floor space ratio 0.5 for a single detached dwelling, 0.65 for a duplex, and 0.9, 1.2 or 1.5 for townhouses of three, four, or five or more units. Lot coverage 40% (50% for townhouses). Townhouses up to 11 m (about 36 ft) or three storeys; other homes 9.5 m.

zones.name: Townhouse 2 Zone
fields: Intended to enable a transition from small-scale residential development to ground-oriented multi-unit residential development on lands abutting an Arterial Road or a Collector Road and designated Townhouse in the OCP.
Up to 3 dwelling units on a lot of 280 m² or less and 4 on a larger lot; no maximum on a lot over 1,120 m² that is wider than 35 m.
495 m² (about 5,328 sq ft), at least 20 m wide.
Floor space ratio 0.9, 1.2 or 1.5 for townhouses of three, four, or five or more units. Townhouses up to 11 m (about 36 ft) or three storeys.
zones.note: Summary from the City of Abbotsford's SSMUH Application Guide (January 2026), not the bylaw page.

zones.name: Duplex Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings or duplexes (strata and fee simple) on urban lots.
A duplex or one single detached dwelling. A secondary suite is allowed in a single detached dwelling only.
Boarding, a home-based business and residential care.
464 m² (about 4,994 sq ft) and 15 m wide for a single detached dwelling; 557 m² and 18 m wide for a duplex; 278 m² and 9 m wide for each half of a duplex divided along the shared wall. 25 m deep.
Floor space ratio 0.50. Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 9.5 m (about 31 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Duplex Residential Zone, Infill
fields: Intended for duplexes (strata and fee simple) on urban lots in the Urban 3-Infill Land Use Designation.
Boarding, a home-based business and short-term rental.
540 m² (about 5,813 sq ft) and 18 m wide, or 270 m² and 9 m wide for each half of a duplex divided along the shared wall. 25 m deep.
Floor space ratio 0.5. Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 8.5 m (about 28 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings on standard lots without lane access.
One single detached dwelling, which can have a secondary suite.
Boarding, a home-based business, short-term rental, residential care and a boarding house.
420 m² (about 4,521 sq ft) for an interior lot and 480 m² for a corner lot, at least 13 m wide and 22.5 m deep.
Floor space ratio 0.65. Lot coverage 45%. Buildings up to 9.5 m (about 31 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings on standard lots without secondary suites or lane access.
One single detached dwelling. Secondary suites are not on the list of permitted uses.
Boarding, a home-based business, short-term rental, residential care and a boarding house.
420 m² (about 4,521 sq ft) for an interior lot and 480 m² for a corner lot, at least 13 m wide and 22.5 m deep.
Floor space ratio 0.65. Lot coverage 45%. Buildings up to 9.5 m (about 31 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Compact Lot Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings on compact lots.
One single detached dwelling. Secondary suites are not on the list of permitted uses.
Boarding, a home-based business and residential care.
300 m² (about 3,229 sq ft). With a rear lane: 9.5 m wide and 31 m deep (corner lots 360 m² and 11.5 m wide). Without a lane: 12 m wide and 22.5 m deep.
Floor space ratio 0.65, with floor area capped at 273 m² (about 2,939 sq ft) on lots over 420 m². Lot coverage 45%. Buildings up to 9.5 m (about 31 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Compact Lot Coach House Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings and coach houses above accessory buildings on compact lots with rear lane access.
One single detached dwelling and a coach house above an accessory building.
Boarding, a home-based business and residential care.
300 m² (about 3,229 sq ft), 9.5 m wide and 31 m deep for an interior lot; 360 m² and 11.5 m wide for a corner lot.
Floor space ratio 0.65, not counting the coach house. Lot coverage 45%. Buildings up to 9.5 m (about 31 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Infill Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings and garden suites on compact lots in the SSMUH 1 and Townhouse Land Use Designation.
One single detached dwelling with either a secondary suite or one garden suite of up to 55 m² (about 592 sq ft), not both.
Boarding, a home-based business and residential care.
300 m² (about 3,229 sq ft) and 10 m wide for an interior lot; 375 m² and 15 m wide for a corner lot; 22.5 m deep.
Floor space ratio 0.5. Lot coverage 40% where the front lot line is 12 m or more, 45% where it is 10 m to 11.99 m. Buildings up to 8.5 m (about 28 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Coach House Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings and coach houses on urban lots with municipal lane access in the Urban 3 – Infill Land Use Designation and new neighbourhoods.
One single detached dwelling plus one coach house per lot.
Boarding, a home-based business and residential care.
300 m² (about 3,229 sq ft) and 9 m wide for an interior lot; 360 m² and 11 m wide for a corner lot; 31 m deep.
Floor space ratio 0.5, not counting the coach house. Lot coverage 50%. Buildings up to 8.5 m (about 28 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Infill Manufactured Home Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings and fee simple manufactured homes on urban lots.
One single detached dwelling, which can be a manufactured home on its own fee simple lot.
A home-based business and short-term rental.
495 m² (about 5,328 sq ft) and 20 m wide for an interior lot; 585 m² and 23 m wide for a corner lot; 22.5 m deep.
Floor space ratio 0.65, or 0.5 for a manufactured home. Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 11 m (about 36 ft) or three storeys; a manufactured home 6 m and one storey.

zones.name: Urban Residential Hybrid Zone
fields: Intended for conventional single detached dwellings and fee simple mobile homes on urban lots.
One single detached dwelling, which can be an approved A277 or Z240 manufactured or mobile home.
540 m² (about 5,813 sq ft), 15 m wide and 25 m deep for an interior lot; 610 m² and 18 m wide for a corner lot.
Floor space ratio 0.5. Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 7.5 m (about 25 ft) or two storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Residential Corner Store Zone
fields: Intended for residential uses with accessory commercial uses in primarily residential areas in the Urban 3 – Infill or Urban 4 – Detached Land Use Designations in accordance with the policy contained within the Official Community Plan.
A duplex or one single detached dwelling. A secondary suite is allowed in a single detached dwelling only.

Small commercial uses alongside the home: retail, a coffee shop or restaurant, office, health care office, personal services and a child care centre. Boarding, a home-based business and residential care.
Floor space ratio 0.50. Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 7.5 m (about 25 ft) or two storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Low Density Townhouse Zone
fields: Intended for townhouse developments at lower densities, up to 16 units per hectare.
Townhouses, up to 16 dwelling units per hectare (about 6 per acre).
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 9.5 m (about 31 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Low Density Townhouse Zone
fields: Intended for townhouse developments at lower densities, up to 30 units per hectare.
Townhouses, up to 30 dwelling units per hectare (about 12 per acre).
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 11 m (about 36 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Medium Density Townhouse Zone
fields: Intended for townhouse developments at medium densities, up to 45 units per hectare.
Townhouses, up to 45 dwelling units per hectare (about 18 per acre).
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 11 m (about 36 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: High Density Townhouse Zone
fields: Intended for townhouse developments at higher densities, up to 60 units per hectare.
Townhouses, up to 60 dwelling units per hectare (about 24 per acre).
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 11 m (about 36 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Multifamily Ground Oriented Zone
fields: Intended to enable ground oriented multi-unit residential development for lands designated Townhouse in the OCP.
Floor space ratio 0.5 to 1.5. Lot coverage 45%. Buildings up to 11 m (about 36 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Multi-Unit Residential Flex Zone
fields: Intended for townhouse developments at higher densities, up to 60 units per hectare, and to allow for secondary suites within townhouses.
Townhouses, up to 60 dwelling units per hectare (about 24 per acre). Each townhouse can have one secondary suite of 30 m² to 90 m² (about 323 to 969 sq ft).
Boarding (not in a unit that has a secondary suite) and a home-based business.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 11 m (about 36 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Multiplex Residential Zone
fields: Intended to establish specific land use and development regulations for three and four unit townhouse developments on existing urban lots in the Townhouse Land Use Designation.
A multiplex of townhouse-style homes, up to four dwelling units per lot.
Floor space ratio 0.5 to 1.5. Lot coverage 55%. Buildings up to 9.5 m (about 31 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Rowhouse Residential Zone
fields: Intended to enable rowhouse development on consolidated lots that are designated Townhouse in the OCP.
Rowhouses, each on its own lot.
With a rear lane: 140 m² (about 1,507 sq ft) and 4.5 m wide for an internal lot, 180 m² for an end lot and 235 m² for a corner lot, 32 m deep. Without a lane: 150 m², 185 m² and 235 m², 28 m deep.
Floor space ratio 0.5 to 1.5. Lot coverage 65%. Buildings up to 11 m (about 36 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Low Rise Apartment Zone
fields: Intended for low-rise developments up to six storeys in height, including residential buildings and buildings for congregate care.
Floor space ratio 1.4, or up to 1.70 with a density bonus. Lot coverage 40% (45% with the bonus). Buildings up to 21.3 m (about 70 ft) or six storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Mid Rise Apartment Zone
fields: Intended for mid-rise developments up to six (6) storeys in height, including residential buildings and buildings for congregate care, for lands designated Apartment in the City’s Official Community Plan.
Apartments and congregate housing, with lock-off units allowed.
Boarding, a home-based business and assembly use.

Floor space ratio 1.0 to 2.0, or up to 2.5 on existing or consolidated properties of 2,500 m² or less. Lot coverage 50%. Buildings up to 21.3 m (about 70 ft) or six storeys, whichever is less. Certain listed lots can reach 40 m or 12 storeys.

zones.name: Mid Rise Apartment Zone – Rental
fields: Intended for mid-rise developments up to six (6) storeys in height, including residential buildings and buildings for congregate care which are restricted to residential rental tenure only, for lands designated Apartment in the City’s Official Community Plan.
Rental apartments and congregate housing, with lock-off units allowed.

Ground-level commercial such as retail, restaurants, coffee shops, offices, a financial institution, child care centre, liquor store and animal hospital. Boarding, a home-based business and assembly use.
Floor space ratio 1.0 to 2.5. Lot coverage 50%. Buildings up to 21.3 m (about 70 ft) or six storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: High Rise Apartment Zone
fields: Intended for high-rise developments up to 80 metres in height, including residential buildings and buildings for congregate care.

zones.name: Mixed Use Apartment Zone
fields: Intended for low-rise, mixed-use developments up to six storeys in height, consisting of limited commercial uses on the first and second floors and apartment or congregate housing uses on upper floors.
Apartments and congregate housing in a mixed-use building.

Commercial space such as retail, restaurants, coffee shops, offices, health care offices, a financial institution, child care centre, personal services, pet daycare and liquor store. Boarding and a home-based business.
Floor space ratio 1.75, plus up to 1.0 more where parking is underground. Lot coverage 75%. Buildings up to 21.3 m (about 70 ft) or six storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: City Centre Residential Zone
fields: Intended for multi storey residential buildings for lands designated City Centre Core or City Centre Residential in the City Centre Neighbourhood Plan.
Apartments and congregate housing, with lock-off units allowed.

Commercial space such as retail, restaurants, pubs, offices, health care offices, a financial institution, child care centre, indoor recreation and personal services. Boarding and a home-based business.
Floor space ratio 1.5 to 2.75 (3.5 in a Transit-Oriented Area), and up to 6.5 with a density bonus. Lot coverage 75%. Buildings must be at least three storeys; the zone page states no maximum height.

zones.name: Manufactured Home Park Zone
fields: Intended for manufactured homes on individual pads within an unsubdivided manufactured home park.
A manufactured home park, with homes on individual pads on one unsubdivided lot.
An accessory residential use and home-based businesses.
Up to 20 dwelling units per hectare (about 8 per acre). Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to two storeys.

zones.name: Local Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for small-scale commercial uses in primarily residential areas.
Retail, a restaurant or coffee shop, office, health care office, personal services, child care centre, indoor recreation, and civic and community services.
Floor space ratio 0.4. Buildings up to 9.5 m (about 31 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Neighbourhood Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for many commercial uses that meet the needs of the broader neighbourhood, in developments up to 10,000 m² in size.

Retail, restaurants (including drive-through), coffee shops, pubs and brew-pubs, liquor stores, offices, health care offices, financial institutions, personal services, child care centres, commercial schools, indoor recreation, animal hospitals, pet daycare, garden centres, funeral parlours, hotels (tourist accommodation), assembly, and civic and community services.
Apartments, only together with a commercial or other principal use.
Floor space ratio 0.60. Lot coverage 50%. Buildings up to 10 m (about 33 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Community Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for many commercial uses that meet the needs of the community, in developments over 10,000 m² in size.

Retail, restaurants (including drive-through), coffee shops, pubs and brew-pubs, liquor stores, offices, health care offices, financial institutions, personal services, child care centres, commercial schools, indoor recreation, animal hospitals, pet daycare, garden centres, funeral parlours, hotels (tourist accommodation), assembly, and civic and community services, plus automobile sales, printing services and off-street parking.
Apartments, only together with a commercial or other principal use.
Floor space ratio 1.3. Lot coverage 50%. Buildings up to 12.2 m (about 40 ft) or three storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Service Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for many commercial uses in buildings two storeys or less, in an automobile-oriented environment.

Automobile sales, repair and body shops, building and landscape supply, garden centres and nurseries, retail, restaurants (including drive-through), coffee shops, liquor stores, personal services, indoor recreation, child care centres, trade schools, animal hospitals, pet daycare, printing, courier depots, a bus depot, recycling depots, funeral parlours, assembly, and civic and community services.
An office, and a crematorium with a funeral parlour.
Floor space ratio 1.0. Lot coverage 50%. Buildings up to 10 m (about 33 ft) or two storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Secondary Commercial Zone
fields: Intended to serve a neighbourhood or city wide area with commercial uses along with indoor industrial, for lands designated Secondary Commercial in the Official Community Plan.

A wide commercial list plus light industry: retail, building and garden supply, restaurants, pubs and breweries, offices, financial and health care offices, personal services, automobile sales and repair, child care, commercial and trade schools, indoor recreation, hotels (tourist accommodation), manufacturing, warehousing, self storage and recycling depots.
Floor space ratio 1.0 on lots under 1,000 m² and 0.5 on larger lots. Lot coverage 50%. Buildings up to 10 m (about 33 ft) or two storeys; a hotel up to 15 m or four storeys.

zones.name: Regional Commercial Zone
fields: Intended to provide for large format retail centres with large anchor tenants and surface parking on lands designated Regional Commercial in the Official Community Plan.

Large-format retail, restaurants, coffee shops, pubs and breweries, liquor stores, offices, financial and health care offices, personal services, automobile sales and repair, building, landscape and garden supply, manufacturing, warehousing, self storage, schools, indoor recreation, child care, hotels (tourist accommodation), assembly, and civic and community services.

Floor space ratio 0.5, with no more than 60% of the floor area in retail units under 4,000 m². Lot coverage 50%. Buildings one storey and up to 12.2 m (about 40 ft); a hotel up to 15 m or four storeys.

zones.name: City Centre Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for many uses appropriate for the City Centre including retail, office, financial, service and residential uses in conjunction with commercial uses, in low-rise buildings up to six storeys.

Retail, restaurants, coffee shops, pubs and brew-pubs, liquor stores, offices, health care offices, financial institutions, commercial schools, personal services, child care centres, indoor recreation, hotels (tourist accommodation), assembly, and civic and community services, plus drive-through restaurants, animal hospitals, funeral parlours, garden centres and off-street parking.
Apartments and congregate housing, only together with a commercial or other principal use.
Floor space ratio 1.75, plus up to 1.0 more where parking is underground. Lot coverage 95%. Buildings up to 21.3 m (about 70 ft) or six storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: City Centre Mixed Use Zone
fields: Intended for multi storey buildings and many uses, for lands designated City Centre Core in the City Centre Neighbourhood Plan.

Retail, restaurants, coffee shops, pubs and brew-pubs, liquor stores, offices, health care offices, financial institutions, commercial schools, personal services, child care centres, indoor recreation, hotels (tourist accommodation), assembly, and civic and community services, plus microbreweries, media studios, printing and pet daycare.
Apartments and congregate housing, with lock-off units allowed.
Boarding, a home-based business and home child care.
Floor space ratio 1.5 to 2.75, and up to 5.0 with a density bonus. Lot coverage 95%. Buildings must be at least three storeys; the zone page states no maximum height.

zones.name: Commercial High Rise Zone
fields: Intended for commercial and mixed-use developments up to 80 metres in height along and within close proximity to the City’s Primary Transit Corridor.

Retail, restaurants, coffee shops, liquor stores, offices, health care offices, financial institutions, personal services, commercial schools, child care centres, indoor recreation, hotels (tourist accommodation), assembly, and civic and community services.
Apartments and congregate housing, only together with a commercial or other principal use.
Floor space ratio 4.5, of which housing can use up to 2.5; with a density bonus, 5.0 in total and up to 3.5 for housing. Lot coverage 95%. Buildings up to 80 m (about 262 ft).

zones.name: Historic Downtown Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for commercial and mixed-use developments in the Historic Downtown area.

Retail, restaurants, coffee shops, pubs and brew-pubs, liquor stores, a farmers market, offices, financial institutions, health care offices, personal services, child care centres, commercial schools, indoor recreation, hotels (tourist accommodation) and civic uses.
Apartments of at least 56 m² (about 603 sq ft) and congregate housing, only together with a commercial or other principal use.
Bed and breakfast, boarding and a home-based business.
Floor space ratio 1.75, plus up to 1.0 more where parking is underground. Lot coverage 95%. Buildings up to 15 m (about 49 ft) or four storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Gas Station Commercial Zone
fields: Intended to provide a zone to meet the specific safety and health standards required to accommodate gas stations, automobile maintenance and repair facilities and other associated uses.
A service station, automobile repair and an automobile body shop.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 6 m (about 20 ft).

zones.name: Automall Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for automobile, commercial vehicle, and recreational vehicle dealerships and other associated uses within an automall format.
Automobile, commercial vehicle and recreational vehicle sales, leasing and repair, automobile body shops, automobile storage yards and automall retail.
An accessory residential use of up to 90 m² inside the main building.
A restaurant of up to 175 m².
Floor space ratio 0.5. Lot coverage 50%. Buildings up to 12.2 m (about 40 ft).

zones.name: Recreation and Campground Zone
fields: Intended for outdoor sport uses, campgrounds and resort accommodation uses on large lots.
Campgrounds, outdoor sports, resort accommodation and assembly.
Miniature golf, mobile food vendors and a seasonal produce stand.
Up to 50 trailer or camping spaces per hectare. Lot coverage 10%. Buildings up to 9.8 m (about 32 ft) or two storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Golf Course Zone
fields: Intended for golf courses and uses associated with golf courses, including accessory buildings, club houses, driving ranges and other associated uses.
Golf courses, miniature golf, campgrounds and assembly.
A clubhouse, driving range, pub, restaurant and seasonal produce stand.
Up to 50 trailer or camping spaces per hectare. Lot coverage 10%. Buildings up to 10 m (about 33 ft) or two storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Urban Centre Zone
fields: Intended to enable a mix of multi-unit residential and commercial uses that serve a city-wide and neighbourhood function, on lands designated Urban Centre in the OCP.

zones.name: Neighbourhood Centre Zone
fields: Intended to enable a mix of multi unit residential and commercial uses that function as neighbourhood gathering places and destinations including shops, restaurants, cafes, and services, on land designated Neighbourhood Centre in the OCP.

zones.name: Residential Industrial Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings on industrial lots, with home based businesses and small-scale industrial uses.
Manufacturing, alongside a single detached dwelling.
Automobile, commercial vehicle, recreational vehicle and farm equipment repair, an automobile body shop, courier and delivery, and a home-based business.
1,000 m² (about 10,764 sq ft), at least 25 m wide and 40 m deep.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 9.8 m (about 32 ft) or two storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Light Industrial Zone
fields: Intended for commercial vehicle parking with a limited number of light industrial uses and outdoor storage.

zones.name: General Industrial Zone
fields: Intended for a mix of light industrial uses.

Manufacturing, warehousing, freight handling and storage, automobile and commercial vehicle services, brewing, recycling and waste facilities, indoor recreation, restaurants, printing and trade schools.
An accessory residential use of up to 90 m² inside the main building.
Lot coverage 60%. Buildings up to 12.2 m (about 40 ft).

zones.name: High Impact Industrial Zone
fields: Intended for high impact industrial uses, as well as a limited number of light industrial uses that are compatible with high impact uses.

Heavy industry: manufacturing, dangerous goods manufacturing and warehousing, batching plants, slaughterhouses, stockyards and feedlots, commercial composting, motor vehicle recycling and salvage yards, recycling depots, waste transfer stations, freight handling, warehousing, and commercial vehicle parking, sales and repair.
An accessory residential use of up to 90 m² inside the main building.
Lot coverage 60%. Buildings up to 12.2 m (about 40 ft).

zones.name: Airport Zone
fields: Intended for airport facilities and limited commercial uses that are complementary to the Abbotsford International Airport.

The airport and airport offices, flying clubs, freight handling, warehousing, manufacturing, trade and commercial schools, dormitories, hotels (tourist accommodation), service stations, off-street parking, civic uses and agriculture.
Automobile rental, restaurants (including drive-through), coffee shops, pubs, liquor stores and retail.
No lot coverage or height figure; buildings must stay below the obstacle limitation surfaces set by Transport Canada and NAV CANADA.

zones.name: Special Industrial Zone
fields: Intended for a variety of site-specific industrial uses.

Uses are listed lot by lot, such as cedar shake mills, woodworking and sawmilling, furniture and pallet manufacturing, freight handling, warehousing, commercial vehicle repair and, on several lots, the I2 uses plus automobile recycling and salvage. Storage must be inside a fully enclosed building.
An accessory residential use of up to 95 m² on some lots.
Lot coverage 75%. Buildings up to 20 m (about 66 ft), or 12 m for some of the listed uses.

zones.name: Civic Institutional Zone
fields: Intended for general civic and institutional uses.
Floor space ratio 2.75. Lot coverage 50%. Buildings up to 18 m (about 59 ft) or six storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Park, Open Space and School Zone
fields: Intended for public uses such as parks, child care centres and schools.
Parks, schools, child care centres and cemeteries.
Lot coverage 20%. Buildings up to 12.2 m (about 40 ft) and at least 6 m from every lot line.

zones.name: Assembly Zone
fields: Intended for assembly and school uses.
Assembly uses (such as places of worship) and schools.
A child care centre and community services.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 9.8 m (about 32 ft) or two storeys, whichever is less, and at least 6 m from every lot line.

zones.name: Special Housing Zone
fields: Intended for congregate housing, congregate care uses and other community support services.
Congregate housing, congregate care and community services.
An accessory residential use inside the main building.
Floor space ratio 1.4. Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 12.2 m (about 40 ft).

zones.name: River Zone
fields: Intended to provide for the use of a river for water-related recreation, storage, transportation and other related uses.
River use. The zone page lists no other uses and sets no lot size, coverage or height figures.

zones.name: Entertainment and Sports Centre Zone
fields: Intended for entertainment and sports uses.
Floor space ratio 1.4. Lot coverage 50%. Buildings up to 21.3 m (about 70 ft) or six storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: University/College Campus Zone
fields: Intended for educational, recreational, residential and commercial uses associated with universities, colleges and other post-secondary educational institutions.

A post-secondary institution with research and development, plus restaurants, coffee shops, pubs, retail, personal services, offices, child care centres, indoor recreation, parks, hotels (tourist accommodation), assembly, and civic and community services.
2,000 m² (about 0.5 acres), at least 30 m wide and deep.
Floor space ratio 1.5. Lot coverage 50%. Buildings up to 21.3 m (about 70 ft) or six storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Health Campus Zone
fields: Intended for uses on lands designated Health Campus in the City’s Official Community Plan.

Health care offices, congregate care and congregate housing, research laboratories, a helicopter landing pad, child care centres, commercial schools, financial institutions, personal services, restaurants, coffee shops, retail, assembly, and civic and community services.
A dormitory, indoor recreation and boarding.
Floor space ratio 0.5 to 2.0. Lot coverage 50%. Buildings up to 21.3 m (about 70 ft) or six storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: N2 … Comprehensive Development Zones
fields: Site-specific zones numbered N1, N2 and up (Section 800). Each has its own permitted uses and rules, so read the zone that applies to the property.

zones.name: Residential Zone
fields: R-1A is the Township of Langley's residential zone for lots from 371.6 m² (about 4,000 sq ft). Each lot can have one of two things: a small-scale multi-unit housing development of up to four homes, or one single family dwelling plus one accessory dwelling unit (a home in a separate accessory building, such as a coach house) where the house has no secondary suite.

Small-scale multi-unit housing means up to four homes on one lot, attached or detached (three if the lot is 280 m² or smaller). To qualify, the lot must be inside the urban containment boundary, smaller than 4,050 m² (about one acre), on municipal water and sanitary sewer, not reached from an arterial road, outside the Willowbrook transit-oriented area and without heritage designation under a bylaw made on or before December 7, 2023.
Accessory buildings, a detached garage and home-based businesses (accessory home occupations, s.104.3).
371.6 m² (about 4,000 sq ft), with at least 12 m (39 ft) of frontage and a depth of 25 m on a front-loaded lot or 28 m on a rear-loaded lot (s.401.8).

Buildings can cover up to 35% of the lot, or 45% where the lot has infill housing: detached homes added beside a house or duplex that was built before the Township's small-scale multi-unit housing amendment (Bylaw No. 6020) and is kept.

Homes can be up to 9 m high (about 29.5 ft). Infill housing within 6 m of the rear lot line is limited to 4.5 m, except coach houses fronting a lane, and accessory buildings that are not homes to 3.75 m. A single family dwelling of 280 m² (about 3,014 sq ft) or more, counting garages and carports but not a basement, is limited to two storeys plus a basement, with a second storey no larger than 80% of the first.

Infill housing within 7.5 m of the rear lot line is limited to 4.5 m, except coach houses fronting a lane, and accessory buildings that are not homes are limited to 3.75 m. No third storey with one or two homes on the lot; with three homes the third storey can be up to 50% of the first storey's floor area, and with four homes up to 80%. On a lot with driveway access from the street, the main building sits 6.0 m to 7.5 m back from the front lot line, at least 3.0 m from the rear and 1.2 m from an interior side lot line (4.5 m on a side facing a collector or arterial street). Lots with rear lane access have their own setbacks.

zones.name: Residential Mobile Home Park Zone
fields: MH-1 is the Township of Langley's zone for mobile home parks (manufactured home parks). Parks are regulated by the Langley Mobile Home Park Regulation and Control By-law, 1975, No. 1505, which also sets where the mobile homes sit and the parking.
Besides the mobile homes in the park, one single family dwelling for the owner, manager or caretaker and their immediate family.

Accessory buildings and uses, including a convenience store and a campground that go with the park (campgrounds under Langley Campground Regulation Bylaw 1985 No. 2299), and home-based businesses (accessory home occupations, s.104.3).
No more than 20 units per hectare (about 8 per acre) in the park. Buildings can cover up to 40% of the lot. In the Fort Langley area mapped in s.104.5, buildings are limited to 9 m and two storeys.

zones.name: Residential Float Home Zone
fields: Up to 40 float homes moored at a Class "C" marina, plus one single family dwelling or mobile home on the upland lot for the owner, manager or caretaker.

Float homes can cover up to 45% of the water lot, and buildings up to 40% of the upland lot. Float homes are up to 8 m (about 26 ft) or 2.5 storeys high and at least 3 m of open water apart. Amenity open space on the upland equal to 30% of the water lot area.

zones.name: Multiple Family Residential Zone
fields: RM-1 is the Township of Langley's lowest-density multi-family zone: townhouses. Up to one dwelling unit per 335 m² of lot area, which is 30 units per hectare (about 12 per acre).
Group children's day care and home-based businesses (accessory home occupations, s.104.3).
Lot coverage 30%. Buildings up to 9 m (about 30 ft) and 2.5 storeys. Each development must also provide a private landscaped amenity area sized by the number of bedrooms.

zones.name: Multiple Family Residential Zone
fields: RM-2 is a Township of Langley multi-family zone for townhouses and apartments. Up to one dwelling unit per 225 m² of lot area, which is 44 units per hectare (about 18 per acre).
Group children's day care and home-based businesses (accessory home occupations, s.104.3).
Lot coverage 35%. Buildings up to 9 m (about 30 ft) and 2.5 storeys. Each development must also provide a private landscaped amenity area sized by the number of bedrooms.

zones.name: Multiple Family Residential Zone
fields: RM-3 is a Township of Langley multi-family zone for apartments and townhouses. Up to one dwelling unit per 135 m² of lot area, which is 74 units per hectare (about 30 per acre).
Group children's day care and home-based businesses (accessory home occupations, s.104.3).
Lot coverage 35%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft) and three storeys. Each development must also provide a private landscaped amenity area sized by the number of bedrooms.

zones.name: Multiple Family Residential Zone
fields: RM-3A is a Township of Langley multi-family zone for apartments and townhouses up to four storeys. Up to one dwelling unit per 135 m² of lot area, which is 74 units per hectare (about 30 per acre).
Group children's day care and home-based businesses (accessory home occupations, s.104.3).
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 15 m (about 49 ft) and four storeys. Each development must also provide a private landscaped amenity area sized by the number of bedrooms.

zones.name: Multiple Family Residential Zone
fields: RM-4 is the Township of Langley's highest-density RM zone: apartments. Up to one dwelling unit per 80 m² of lot area, which is 124 units per hectare (about 50 per acre).
Group children's day care and home-based businesses (accessory home occupations, s.104.3).
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 15 m (about 49 ft) and four storeys. Each development must also provide a private landscaped amenity area sized by the number of bedrooms.

zones.name: Fraser River Zone
fields: Uses on and along the Fraser River.
River uses and accessory uses on and along the Fraser River. The bylaw lists no other permitted uses and no minimum lot size for the zone.

zones.name: Rural Game Farm Zone
fields: Game farm or zoological park, with up to 4 dwellings.

zones.name: Canadian Forces Station Zone
fields: RU-13 is the Township of Langley's Canadian Forces Station zone. It allows a Canadian Forces Station and facilities under the federal Department of National Defence, agricultural uses, and post-secondary degree-granting colleges and universities under the provincial ministry (the only assembly use allowed).
Accessory residential use, and accessory buildings and uses.
Buildings can cover up to 33% of the lot and must be at least 10 m (about 33 ft) from every property line.

zones.name: Regional Commercial Zone
fields: C-1 is the Township of Langley's regional commercial zone: commercial uses, highway commercial uses, assembly uses, group children's day care, licensee retail stores (liquor stores), liquor primary establishments and a refund container return centre of up to 280 m².
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Community Commercial Zone
fields: C-2 is the Township of Langley's community commercial zone. Commercial uses, hotels, assembly uses, group children's day care, licensee retail stores (liquor stores), liquor primary establishments and a refund container return centre of up to 280 m².
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Community Commercial Zone
fields: Every C-2 use, plus the sale, leasing and servicing of recreational vehicles.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Community Commercial Zone
fields: Every C-2 use, plus gas bars, and a brewery or distillery with a lounge on one named lot.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Community Commercial Zone
fields: Every C-2 use, plus a family entertainment centre on one named strata lot.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Community Commercial Zone
fields: Every C-2 use except retail stores larger than 450 m², plus gas bars.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Service Commercial Zone
fields: C-3 is the Township of Langley's service commercial zone: highway commercial uses, furniture and appliance stores, home improvement centres, automotive parts stores, vehicle servicing and repair, service stations and gas bars, restaurants, convenience stores (up to 450 m²), personal services, veterinary clinics, funeral homes, wholesale distribution, commercial recreation and instruction, and assembly uses.
Residential use accessory to a commercial use.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Service Commercial Zone
fields: Every C-3 use, plus a liquor primary establishment.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to four storeys.

zones.name: Neighbourhood Commercial Zone
fields: A convenience store of up to 450 m² (about 4,844 sq ft) and the sale of seasonal agricultural products.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 9 m (about 30 ft).

zones.name: Neighbourhood Commercial Zone
fields: A convenience store of up to 450 m² (about 4,844 sq ft), a gas bar and the sale of seasonal agricultural products.
Residential use accessory to the convenience store.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 9 m (about 30 ft).

zones.name: Service Station Zone
fields: Service stations, gas bars, restaurants, a convenience store of up to 450 m² and the sale of seasonal agricultural products.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 9 m (about 30 ft).

zones.name: Limited Commercial Zone
fields: Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 11 m (about 36 ft).

zones.name: Limited Commercial Zone
fields: Restaurants, plus every use allowed in the RU-1 Rural zone.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Campground Commercial Zone
fields: Campgrounds under Langley Campground Regulation By-law 1985 No. 2299, with a laundromat and convenience store for the campground.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Customs Commercial Zone
fields: Border services: Canada Customs facilities, customs brokers' offices, duty free shops, a currency exchange, a tourist information office, and the sale of sport fishing licences and equipment.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 9 m (about 30 ft).

zones.name: Farm Auction Zone
fields: Farm auctions, plus every use allowed in the RU-1 Rural zone.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Liquor Primary Zone
fields: A liquor primary establishment and a licensee retail store (liquor store).

zones.name: Limited Commercial Zone
fields: Offices, financial institutions and professional buildings up to 1,125 m² in total, and restaurants up to 214 m².

zones.name: Limited Commercial Zone
fields: Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 9 m (about 30 ft).

zones.name: Limited Commercial Zone
fields: Retail sales of goods and services in up to 91 m² (about 980 sq ft) of floor area.
Residential use accessory to the commercial use.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 9 m (about 30 ft).

zones.name: Limited Commercial Zone
fields: A farm implement sales and service dealership, and the sale, service and rental of landscaping, nursery and garden equipment. Industrial equipment is excluded.
Lot coverage 33%. Buildings up to two storeys.

zones.name: Carvolth Commercial Zone
fields: The commercial uses of the C-2 zone and the uses of the C-3 and C-18 zones, each with a floor area limit per lot.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 15 m (about 49 ft).

zones.name: Carvolth Business Park Zone
fields: The C-3 Service Commercial uses without large-format stores (furniture and appliance stores, home improvement centres, home electronics stores, computer stores over 450 m²), and the M-1A Service Industrial uses without trucking terminals, towing compounds and salvage yards. Retail outlets over 450 m² are not allowed as accessory uses.

zones.name: Service Industrial Zone
fields: M-1A is a Township of Langley service industrial zone: light manufacturing, assembly and repair, warehousing, wholesaling and storage, trade contractor workshops, trucking terminals, vehicle sales, servicing, repair and body shops, building supplies and lumber yards, nurseries and garden supply centres, auction marts, bakeries, breweries and distilleries, printing, production studios, veterinary clinics, dog daycare, restaurants, service stations and gas bars, and commercial recreation and instruction.
Residential use accessory to an industrial use.
Lot coverage 60%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Service Industrial Zone
fields: M-1B has the same uses as M-1A on larger lots: light manufacturing, assembly and repair, warehousing, wholesaling and storage, trade contractor workshops, trucking terminals, vehicle sales, servicing, repair and body shops, building supplies and lumber yards, nurseries and garden supply centres, auction marts, bakeries, breweries and distilleries, printing, production studios, veterinary clinics, dog daycare, restaurants, service stations and gas bars, and commercial recreation and instruction.
Residential use accessory to an industrial use.
Lot coverage 60%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: General Industrial Zone
fields: Every M-1A and M-1B use, plus general industrial uses.
Lot coverage 60%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: General Industrial Zone
fields: Every M-2 use, plus the processing, manufacture and repair of heavy machinery, heavy equipment and heavy transportation products.
Lot coverage 60%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: General Industrial Zone
fields: Every M-2 use, plus meat processing plants (not abattoirs).
Lot coverage 60%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Heavy Industrial Zone
fields: Every M-2 use except production studios, plus agro-industrial uses (not abattoirs), cargo handling and wharf facilities, a ready-mix concrete plant, processing and outside storage of sand, gravel, soil and wood products, heavy machinery manufacture and repair, and recycling depots.

zones.name: Heavy Industrial Zone
fields: Every M-3 use except a ready-mix concrete plant, plus meat processing plants, recycling depots, a refund container return centre, and sawmills, shake mills and shingle mills with no burning of waste.

zones.name: Limited Industrial Zone
fields: Sawmills, shake mills and shingle mills, with no burning of waste material.
Lot coverage 35%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Limited Industrial Zone
fields: Lumber remanufacturing plants, agricultural uses and an intensive swine operation, with no on-site storage or burning of waste material.
Lot coverage 35%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Limited Industrial Zone
fields: Construction of farm buildings, silos and manure tanks, and the development, manufacture, assembly and distribution of refrigeration units and related equipment.
Lot coverage 60%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Salvage Industrial Zone
fields: Wrecking and salvaging yards, vehicle towing and storage yards, and a refund container return centre.

zones.name: Industrial Transition Zone
fields: Every M-1A and M-1B use, plus campgrounds with a laundromat and convenience store for the campground.
Lot coverage 40%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Limited Industrial Zone
fields: Storage and an industrial access driveway that serve a permitted use on a neighbouring M-1B property.

zones.name: Business/Office Park Zone
fields: Business and professional offices, research and development laboratories, assembly uses, commercial recreation and instruction, and size-limited commercial uses. No outside storage.
Lot coverage 50%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Rural Service Industrial Zone
fields: Agricultural uses, farm auctions, nursery and garden supply centres, public works yards, and accessory retail, offices, open storage and commercial vehicle parking.

zones.name: Heavy Industrial Zone
fields: Every M-3 use except a ready-mix concrete plant, plus asphalt batch plants.

zones.name: Brookswood Employment Zone
fields: Scientific and technical research, information technology, warehousing and wholesaling, a brewery or distillery, restaurants, public works yards, and accessory offices, retail and open storage. Added to the bylaw on July 27, 2026.
Residential use accessory to a permitted use.
Lot coverage 60%. Buildings up to 12 m (about 39 ft).

zones.name: Civic Institutional Zone
fields: Government buildings and facilities, hospitals and medical clinics, public parks, playgrounds and recreation facilities, assembly uses, cemeteries, group children's day care, adult day care, public transportation depots, and agricultural uses in the ALR.
Residential use accessory to a permitted use.
Lot coverage 50%. Seniors' housing up to 15 m and four storeys.

zones.name: Civic Institutional Zone
fields: Every P-1 use, plus a Municipal Operations Centre with public works yards, maintenance and storage.

zones.name: Community Care Facility Zones
fields: Community care facilities, supportive housing, adult day care, and agricultural uses in the ALR. Each lettered zone (P-2A, P-2B and so on) sets its own limit on the kind of care and the number of residents.

zones.name: Residential Institutional Zone
fields: Assembly uses, group children's day care, and agricultural uses in the ALR.

zones.name: Residential Institutional Zone
fields: Every P-1 and P-3 use, plus commercial uses of up to 225 m² in total.

zones.name: Airport Zone
fields: Airports, airfields and landing strips with airport-related commercial and industrial uses, public works yards, agricultural uses in the ALR, and RV and boat storage on up to 5% of the site.

zones.name: Limited Institutional Zone
fields: Institutional buildings, public parks, playgrounds and recreation facilities, public works yards, refuse disposal facilities, sand, gravel and soil extraction and processing, and agricultural uses.

zones.name: Limited Institutional Zone
fields: Every P-5 use, plus dehydration plants.

zones.name: Post Office Zone
fields: Lot coverage 60%. Buildings up to 9 m (about 30 ft) and two storeys.

zones.name: Comprehensive Development Zones
fields: Site-specific zones (CD-1, CD-2 and up), each with its own rules. Check the zone that applies to the property.

munis.name: City of Langley
munis.bylaw: City of Langley Zoning Bylaw, 2025, No. 3300
munis.source: Source: Bylaw PDF on langleycity.ca. Adopted March 9, 2026, replacing Zoning Bylaw 1996, No. 2100. All 20 zones.

zones.name: Suburban Residential Zone
fields: R1 is the City of Langley's zone for single detached dwellings and plex homes on lots of 557 m² or larger. Up to 4 dwelling units per lot, or 6 within 400 m of a frequent transit bus stop. Inside a Transit-Oriented Area: one principal dwelling plus one secondary suite, garden suite or carriage home.

A secondary suite of up to 100 m² and 40% of the building's floor area, or a garden suite or carriage home of up to 100 m² on the ground floor; the owner must live on the lot. A home-based business and a private care facility.
557 m² (about 5,996 sq ft), with at least 16 m of frontage.
Lot coverage 36%. Homes up to 9 m (about 30 ft), or 9.8 m for a three-storey home with a sloped roof; a carriage home 6.8 m; a garden suite 4.6 m.

zones.name: Townhouse Residential Zone
fields: Townhouse complexes and rowhouses, including seniors-oriented housing.
Home-based businesses and, on corner sites, small shops and services (retail under 400 m², offices, eating establishments, personal services).
1,000 m² (about 10,764 sq ft). Rowhouse (party wall) lots: no more than 280 m², with at least 4.5 m of frontage.
Floor area ratio 1.2. Lot coverage 45%. Buildings up to 11 m (about 36 ft).

zones.name: Low Rise Residential Zone
fields: Low-rise apartments and townhouse complexes, congregate housing and seniors-oriented housing.
Home-based businesses and, on corner sites, small shops and services (retail under 400 m², offices, eating establishments, personal services). A child care centre.
1,000 m² (about 10,764 sq ft), with at least 26 m of frontage.
Floor area ratio 2.1, or up to 2.6 with the amenity requirement in s.2.6. Buildings up to 6 storeys.

zones.name: Conder Park Corner Zone
fields: A low-rise mixed-use site: shops, offices, eating establishments, personal and general services, child care, an assembly hall, community services and cultural facilities.
Apartments (multiple unit residential), subject to the Official Community Plan policies for the site.
1,000 m² (about 10,764 sq ft), with at least 26 m of frontage.
Floor area ratio 2.1. Buildings up to 6 storeys.

zones.name: Mid Rise Residential Zone
fields: Mid-rise apartments, congregate housing and seniors-oriented housing.
Home-based businesses and, on corner sites, small shops and services (retail under 400 m², offices, eating establishments, personal services). A child care centre.
1,850 m² (about 0.46 acres), with at least 40 m of frontage.
Floor area ratio 3.5. Buildings up to 12 storeys or the airport zoning limit, whichever is less.

zones.name: High Rise Residential Zone
fields: High-rise apartments, congregate housing and seniors-oriented housing.
Local shops and services in the building: retail under 400 m², eating establishments, offices, personal and general services, a child care centre. Home-based businesses.
1,850 m² (about 0.46 acres), with at least 40 m of frontage.
Floor area ratio 4.5. Buildings up to 46 m (about 151 ft) or the airport zoning limit, whichever is less.

zones.name: Langley Lions Seniors District Zone
fields: A 981-unit seniors rental housing site built to a master plan: apartments, congregate housing and seniors-oriented housing.
Floor area ratio 3.0 across the site. Lot coverage 40%. Heights follow the site master plan.

zones.name: Downtown Commercial Zone
fields: Retail, offices, eating establishments, personal and general services, entertainment and cultural facilities, hotels (tourist accommodation), indoor recreation, government and community uses, and child care.
Apartments, seniors-oriented housing and congregate housing, on their own or in mixed-use buildings.
Floor area ratio 2.6, or up to 3.5 with a density bonus on land designated Mixed Use. Buildings up to 46 m (about 151 ft) or the airport zoning limit.

zones.name: Service Commercial Zone
fields: Automotive sales, rental and service, gasoline stations, equipment sales and rental, garden centres, retail, offices, eating establishments, personal services, hotels (tourist accommodation), indoor recreation, veterinary clinics, microbreweries, recycling depots and child care.
Floor area ratio 0.5. Lot coverage 90%. Buildings up to 15 m (about 49 ft).

zones.name: Entertainment and Convention Zone
fields: A hotel, convention centre and gaming facility, with accessory retail, eating establishments, offices, a liquor primary establishment and parking.
Floor area ratio 5.5. Lot coverage 95%. Buildings up to 46 m (about 151 ft) or the airport zoning limit, whichever is less.

zones.name: Mixed Employment Zone
fields: Offices, technology industries, laboratories, production studios, light industry, workshops, warehouses, education, indoor recreation, eating establishments, a brewery or vintner and child care.
Floor area ratio 3.0. Lot coverage 90%. Buildings up to 30 m (about 98 ft) and 6 storeys.

zones.name: Light Industrial Zone
fields: Light industry, technology and research laboratories, production studios, automotive service, building supply, equipment sales and rental, freight depots, construction offices, indoor recreation, a brewery or vintner and child care.

zones.name: Service Industrial Zone
fields: Light industry, industrial business services, automotive service, building supply, equipment sales and rental, freight depots, construction offices, indoor recreation, a brewery or vintner and child care.

zones.name: Special Industrial Zone
fields: Three existing mixed-use sites: light industry, automotive service (no autobody), building supply, offices, personal services, a coffee shop, artist studios and child care.
Apartments on the second floor only, with a set number of units at each of the three addresses.
Lot coverage 50%. Buildings up to 15 m or 2 storeys, whichever is less.

zones.name: Public Institutional Zone
fields: Schools, colleges and universities, community centres, cultural facilities, government offices, parks, senior citizens care, community and family services, child care and parking facilities.
Building height is set by the airport zoning limit.

zones.name: Private Institutional Zone
fields: Assembly halls (such as places of worship), private schools, senior citizens care and child care.
Lot coverage 50%. Building height is set by the airport zoning limit.

zones.name: Shelter Zone
fields: A temporary homeless shelter and transitional housing with community and family services and offices.
Lot coverage 50%. Building height is set by the airport zoning limit.

zones.name: Golf Course Zone
fields: A golf course with indoor recreation, an assembly hall, artist studios and child care, plus an accessory eating establishment and liquor primary establishment.
Lot coverage 50%. Building height is set by the airport zoning limit.

zones.name: University District Zone
fields: Colleges and universities, research laboratories, technology industries, offices, a convention centre, hotels (tourist accommodation), cultural facilities, recreation and small shops and eating establishments, mainly on the KPU campus.
Floor area ratio 3.5, or up to 4.0 with an Official Campus Plan. Buildings up to 46 m (about 151 ft) or the airport zoning limit, whichever is less.

zones.name: Agricultural Zone
fields: One single detached dwelling, with a home-based business allowed.

munis.name: Surrey
munis.source: Source: Consolidated PDF on surrey.ca (updated Sept 23, 2026). Residential zones R1 to R7 replaced the RF, RH and RQ zones on July 8, 2024. Former codes are shown on each card.

zones.name: General Agriculture Zone
fields: Agriculture on lots of at least 2 ha, protecting land designated Agricultural in the OCP.

Agriculture and horticulture; one single family dwelling (which may contain one secondary suite); intensive agriculture (inside the ALR only); farm alcohol production; forestry; horse riding and boarding. Agri-tourism and kennels are limited to 10% building coverage.
4 ha (about 9.9 acres) inside the ALR; 2 ha (about 4.9 acres) outside it.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Intensive Agriculture Zone
fields: General and intensive agriculture, inside or outside the ALR.
Aquaculture; soil processing (outside the ALR unless authorized).
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Acreage Residential Zone
fields: Acreage lots typically 4,050 m² (about 1 acre) or larger, with up to 2 dwelling units. Existing lots under 4,050 m² may have small-scale multi-unit housing of 2 to 6 units.

Lots of 4,050 m² (about 1 acre) or more: up to 2 dwelling units. Smaller existing lots: up to 4 on a lot of 280 m² to under 4,050 m² (single family dwelling or duplex, with secondary suite, garden suite or coach house), up to 6 on an eligible lot in a Frequent Bus Stop Area, and up to 2 inside a Transit-Oriented Area; up to 3 on a lot under 280 m². Heritage-protected lots and lots not on community water or sewer: no more than 2.

On lots of 4,050 m² or more: agriculture and horticulture, a hobby kennel, horse boarding and the sale of farm products grown on the property (up to 93 m²). Bed and breakfast, boarders or lodgers, and short-term rental.
4,050 m² (about 1 acre), at least 50 m wide and 60 m deep, and no more than 2.5 lots per hectare (about 1 per acre).

Lot coverage 20% in general, rising on small lots to 40% at 560 m² or less. Single family dwelling up to 9 m (about 30 ft); duplex up to 3 storeys including the basement and 11 m (about 36 ft); coach house or garden suite up to 2 storeys and 7 m (about 23 ft). A coach house or garden suite is 35 m² to 75 m² (about 377 to 807 sq ft).

zones.name: Suburban Residential Zone
fields: Small-scale multi-unit housing (2 to 6 units) on suburban lots typically larger than 1,858 m² (about 0.46 acres).
Only on lots of 2 ha or more, excluding poultry, mushroom, piggery and mink operations.

On a lot of 280 m² to under 4,050 m²: up to 4 dwelling units (single family dwelling or duplex), up to 6 on an eligible lot in a Frequent Bus Stop Area, and up to 2 inside a Transit-Oriented Area. Lots under 280 m²: up to 3 (2 inside a Transit-Oriented Area). Lots of 4,050 m² or more: up to 2. Secondary suites, garden suites and coach houses are allowed as accessory uses.
A hobby kennel. Bed and breakfast, boarders or lodgers, and short-term rental.
1,858 m² (about 0.46 acres), at least 30 m wide and 30 m deep, and no more than 5 lots per hectare (about 2 per acre).

Lot coverage for a single family dwelling runs from 40% on lots of 560 m² or less down to 25% on lots over 1,262 m²; a duplex 50% down to 35%. Single family dwelling up to 9 m (about 30 ft); duplex up to 3 storeys including the basement and 11 m (about 36 ft); coach house or garden suite up to 2 storeys and 7 m (about 23 ft). A coach house or garden suite is 35 m² to 75 m² (about 377 to 807 sq ft).

zones.name: Quarter Acre Residential Zone
fields: Intended for small-scale multi-unit housing on large lots typically 930 m² or larger, which may accommodate 2 to 6 dwelling units, where lot size may be reduced with substantial public open space set aside within the subdivision.

On a lot of 280 m² to under 4,050 m²: up to 4 dwelling units (single family dwelling or duplex), up to 6 on an eligible lot in a Frequent Bus Stop Area, and up to 2 inside a Transit-Oriented Area. Lots under 280 m²: up to 3 (2 inside a Transit-Oriented Area). Lots of 4,050 m² or more: up to 2. Secondary suites, garden suites and coach houses are allowed as accessory uses.
Bed and breakfast, boarders or lodgers, and short-term rental.

930 m² (about 10,010 sq ft), at least 24 m wide and 30 m deep, and no more than 10 lots per hectare (about 4 per acre). Reduced to 775 m² where 15% of the subdivision is set aside as open space, or 700 m² with 30%, both at least 20 m wide.

Lot coverage for a single family dwelling runs from 40% on lots of 560 m² or less down to 25% on lots over 1,262 m²; a duplex 50% down to 35%. Single family dwelling up to 9 m (about 30 ft); duplex up to 3 storeys including the basement and 11 m (about 36 ft); coach house or garden suite up to 2 storeys and 7 m (about 23 ft). A coach house or garden suite is 35 m² to 75 m² (about 377 to 807 sq ft).

zones.name: Oceanfront Residential Zone
fields: Intended for small-scale multi-unit housing on oceanfront lots typically 1,000 m² or larger, which may accommodate 2 to 6 dwelling units, where there are no lots located between the subject lot and the oceanfront, except for railway land.

On a lot of 280 m² to under 4,050 m²: up to 4 dwelling units (single family dwelling or duplex), up to 6 on an eligible lot in a Frequent Bus Stop Area, and up to 2 inside a Transit-Oriented Area. Lots under 280 m²: up to 3 (2 inside a Transit-Oriented Area). Lots of 4,050 m² or more: up to 2. Secondary suites, garden suites and coach houses are allowed as accessory uses.
Bed and breakfast, boarders or lodgers, and short-term rental.
1,000 m² (about 10,764 sq ft), at least 20 m wide and 45 m deep.

Lot coverage for a single family dwelling runs from 40% on lots of 560 m² or less down to 25% on lots over 1,262 m²; a duplex 45% down to 30%. Single family dwelling up to 9 m (about 30 ft); duplex up to 3 storeys including the basement and 11 m (about 36 ft); coach house or garden suite up to 2 storeys and 7 m (about 23 ft). A coach house or garden suite is 35 m² to 75 m² (about 377 to 807 sq ft).

zones.name: Urban Residential Zone
fields: Intended for small-scale multi-unit housing on urban sized lots typically 560 m² or larger, which may accommodate 2 to 6 dwelling units.

On a lot of 280 m² to under 4,050 m²: up to 4 dwelling units (single family dwelling, duplex or houseplex), up to 6 on an eligible lot in a Frequent Bus Stop Area, and up to 2 inside a Transit-Oriented Area. Lots under 280 m²: up to 3 (2 inside a Transit-Oriented Area). Lots of 4,050 m² or more: up to 2. Secondary suites, garden suites and coach houses are allowed as accessory uses.
